headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. In other action, the San Diego Padres took down the Washington Nationals 7-5, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Los Angeles Dodgers have transferred left-handed pitcher Blake Snell to the 60-day injured list due to loose bodies in his left elbow. Teoscar Hernández has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. The Detroit Tigers have also made several roster moves, transferring Brant Hurter to the 60-day injured list with lumbar spine inflammation and placing Casey Mize on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28 with a right adductor inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers made a significant trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 5-6 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking their loss in the matchup. Trevor Larnach led the Twins at the plate with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mason Fluharty earning the win and Braydon Fisher securing the save.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Blake Snell Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers left-handed pitcher Blake Snell has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to loose bodies in his left elbow. This move comes after being initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.
